nina: Quick run-through from today's UX pass on /insights: a keyboard user reported the focus halo vanishing on table rows after virtualization kicks in. Also mini-chart legends are silent to screen readers. Can we triage? rahul: Repro'd on mac/Chrome and Windows/NVDA. Tab into table -> arrow down -> focus flashes then disappears when virtualization recycles the row node. Looks like the focused element is being unmounted. tomi: Short-term fix idea: move the visible focus indicator to a stable wrapper (.row-shell) that virtualization doesn't replace. Use box-shadow for the halo so stacking contexts don't clip it. Also add a forced-colors fallback for high-contrast. eliza: For charts the swatches are decorative spans; screen readers just say "graphic". We should give the chart an accessible name and make legend items explicit (e.g. "
  • "). Also ensure DOM order equals visual order. a11y-bot: Automated note: Axe snapshot (2028-05-02) flagged: focusable hidden element, missing accessible name on chart SVG, and selected-row contrast below 4.5:1 in light theme. rahul: Proposed CSS for ring: `:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(2,110,255,0.92); border-radius: 6px; }` + `@media (forced-colors: active) { .row-shell:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid CanvasText; box-shadow: none; } }` Add `prefers-reduced-motion` guard if we animate. tomi: Also found a hidden analytics anchor inside rows that ended up in the tab order. Change it to "tabindex=\"-1\" aria-hidden=\"true\"" and move tracking to pointer-only handlers. eliza: Announcer idea for virtualization: maintain a visually-hidden live region that reads a short summary when a row becomes focused so users get stable feedback even if the DOM swaps: "
    ". Update its text on focus. rahul: I'll open a small PR: 1) move focus styles to .row-shell and switch to box-shadow, 2) add forced-colors fallback, 3) set hidden anchors tabindex=-1, 4) add sr-announcer update on focus. I'll include a Playwright e2e that tabs into the table, navigates rows, opens the inline menu, and shift-tabs back asserting focus returns. Short snippet: ```js await page.keyboard.press('Tab'); await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown'); await page.keyboard.press('Enter'); // open menu await page.keyboard.press('Tab'); await page.keyboard.press('Shift+Tab'); await expect(page.locator('.row-shell:focus-visible')).toHaveCount(1); ``` tomi: I'll handle legend markup: wrap svg in "
